_doc: Rev 9.0 AM32 EEPROM settings for NANO_H743_AIO_F421. Offsets from AM32 v2.21 Inc/eeprom.h (EEprom_t). Program all four ESCs through ArduPilot BLHeli passthrough (SERVO_BLH_AUTO 1) with the AM32 configurator. Only fields that the Rev 9 gate-drive / dead-time / thermal analysis depends on are pinned here; the rest stay at configurator defaults. Checked by am32_esc/gate_drive_design.py (checks E1, E2; E3 checks the matching FC failsafe in ardupilot/defaults.parm).

settings.why: x10 on AM32's 0..2000 duty scale (main.c:645, 1517) -> 40/2000 of ARR 5000 + 1 = 101 ticks = 842 ns. Must exceed DT_mcu + FD6288Q internal dead time max + MT (688 ns with DEAD_TIME 43), otherwise the shortest commanded HS pulses are swallowed entirely by the dead-time insertion (check E2). The AM32 default (1 -> 208 ns) is below that.
Complementary (synchronous) PWM. The dead-time derivation and the loss model assume the LS conducts in the PWM off-time; with 0 the body diode conducts for the whole off-time (+0.8 V x I).
Fixed frequency. Mode 1 halves ARR at high eRPM (main.c:1977), i.e. up to 2 x pwm_frequency, which is outside the 24 kHz thermal must-pass budget.

kHz. Rev 9 thermal must-pass scenarios (R1-R5) are at 24 kHz; at 48 kHz the 20 A typical point fails (thermal_report I2). Valid range 8..144 (main.c:637); out of range falls back to TIM1_AUTORELOAD = 24 kHz.
Matches ardupilot/defaults.parm SERVO_BLH_POLES 14 so the eRPM->RPM notch reference agrees.

OFF. AM32 v2.21 per-cell (1) and absolute (2) cutoffs both latch LOW_VOLTAGE_CUTOFF, call allOff() and need a power cycle (main.c:2184-2205); mode 1 also guesses cell_count = V/3.70 once at arming. On a quad that drops one motor in flight. The FD6288Q UVLO floor (VBAT >= 5.95 V) is enforced instead by the FC critical battery failsafe (defaults.parm BATT_CRT_VOLT 6.4, BATT_FS_CRT_ACT 1), checked by E3. FD6288Q UVLO itself is self-recovering (0.3 V hysteresis).

10 disables dead_time_override. Values 1..9 OR (not add) DEAD_TIME + 150 - 10*s into TMR1_BRK.DTC (main.c:699-711), giving a non-monotonic 0.93..2.12 us dead time with DEAD_TIME 43 (gate_drive_report.json dead_time.driving_brake_override).

C, AT32F421 internal die sensor (ADC_CH16) converted with typical V25/slope constants, no per-part calibration: it tracks the board near the MCU, not FET junctions, and has a part-to-part tolerance of several K. Above the limit AM32 applies a step derate (duty_max = map(T, L-10, L+10, max, 1), ~22 % at L+1) on that motor, i.e. a last-resort limit, not a flyable derate. Valid 70..140, anything else disables it (main.c:724). The Rev 9 burst ratings end >= 5 K below 115 C board temperature; bring-up must measure the die-sensor-to-board offset (open item).
Current limit off: the AIO has one battery shunt read by the H743 (HAL_BATT_CURR_PIN), no per-channel amplifier. The AT32 PA6 current input is tied to GND via 10 k, so AM32 reports 0 A.
